title: Bulgaria Faces Twin Tests of State Capacity · 10 Sep
keywords: Bulgaria, EU recovery funds, fiscal policy, inflation, road safety, governance reform, Eurostat, National Bank of Bulgaria, public finances, European Commission, state capacity, Balkans
notes: Bulgaria's government is leaning heavily on EU recovery funds to stabilize strained public finances, even as inflation remains well above comfortable levels and pressure mounts over a persistent road safety crisis. The two issues together have become a referendum on whether Sofia can deliver basic state functions. For citizens and Brussels alike, the stakes extend well beyond technocratic debate.
